_doc: Goods traded and stockpiled by settlements. base: reference price in coin per unit. need: units one person wants per year (stock target is need * target_years). use: units one person consumes per year, so demand never ends (food is eaten by SimEconomy.EAT instead, tools and luxuries wear out). spoil: fraction lost per year. carry: units one wagon holds. cap: raw goods only, units a day a size-1 site of a 1.0 biome yields at full labour (data/sim/biomes.json gives the biome's share); labour: how fast workers approach that cap, craft: the culture's craft scales it. Water comes up by itself, to the biome's cap with no labour. What each good is for: timber lets families grow; ore and timber make tools; salt keeps the granary from spoiling; reagents are medicine; stone keeps walls standing; game is eaten when the food runs out; water waters the fields; luxuries lift morale; crystal is cut into fine goods before ore is, and lights and wards wear it out.
